description: A low-impact full-body conditioning movement moving between a deep squat and a push-up plank.
setup: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms hanging naturally at your sides.
steps: Drop down into a squat and place your palms flat on the floor in front of your feet.
Step or kick both feet back together into a strong push-up plank position.
Step or jump your feet back forward outside of your hands.
Stand tall and extend hips fully to return to starting position.
cues: Brace core firmly as feet kick back into the plank
Plant palms flat on the floor to protect your wrists

mistakes.mistake: Hips sagging below parallel when in the back plank
mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and abs to keep plank straight without arching spine

mistakes.mistake: Standing up with a rounded hunched back
mistakes.fix: Lift chest and push hips through to stand with tall posture

rep_standard: Begins standing, hands reach floor, feet extend into a rigid plank, and finishes back at full standing hip extension.
